svg.text: PR evidence - GUMROAD-1QS: bound the grouped-receipt load
issue: https://gumroad-to.sentry.io/issues/7750062023/ (same stack as GUMROAD-1KM, 39 events since 2026-09-14)
branch: gumclaw/g1qs-grouped-receipt-load-bound file: app/mailers/customer_mailer.rb
1. Production replica measurement (read-only, 2026-09-23)
Affected caller: /charge_data and the license-lookup flow for one buyer email that matches
31,964 successful purchases (ids 35,503 - 354,953,849). Every id is passed to CustomerMailer.
$ Purchase.where(id: <31,964 ids>).all_success_states_including_test.order(id: :desc)
.includes(charge: [:order, :seller]).to_a
-> killed at the 60s statement cap (production ceiling is 300s: the event fires exactly 300s
after the last SQL breadcrumb)
$ ... same chain over one 200-id window
-> 200 rows in 0.75s, and for a 1,344-purchase buyer the window resolves 110 chargeables
(the email renders at most 20), so the read stops after one window in every measured case
2. Why a flat window is not enough (read-only replica, 2026-09-23)
$ SELECT charge_id, COUNT(*) FROM charge_purchases GROUP BY charge_id ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1
-> 224 purchases in ONE charge
$ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT charge_id FROM charge_purchases GROUP BY charge_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 10) t
-> 285,422 charges hold more than 10 purchases (68,291 hold more than 20)
So a fixed 200-purchase window is not 10x headroom: those rows can collapse into a handful of
chargeables, and the receipts the window never reached are silently left out.
$ a buyer with 246 successful purchases:
newest-200 window -> 13 chargeables whole match -> 15 chargeables
-> the flat window dropped 2 of that buyer's receipts (Greptile P1, confirmed on live data).
3. Red -> green, and what the new examples catch
$ DISABLE_SPRING=1 CI=1 bundle exec rspec spec/mailers/customer_mailer_spec.rb
-> 136 examples, 0 failures (35.5s)
the 2 failures the first round recorded (spec:683, spec:1466) do not reproduce under CI=1
$ mutant A: .first(GROUPED_RECEIPT_READ_WINDOWS) -> .first(1) (the flat-window read)
-> 2 examples, 2 failures (both new examples bite)
$ mutant B: .sort.reverse -> .sort (oldest-first window)
-> 2 examples, 1 failure (the newest-first example bites)
4. Effect on the rendered email
Callers matching up to a window are read in one query, as before; callers past it are read in
newest-first windows until the template can be filled (20 chargeables) or the window budget is
reached, so a 246-purchase buyer gets all 15 receipts again instead of 13. Each receipt block is
still rendered from its chargeable, newest last, capped at GROUPED_RECEIPT_MAX_CHARGEABLES = 20.
